title: Working with Julia Lee, Prince Stewart and Odell West
summary: Smith worked around Kansas City with Julia Lee and Dee (Prince) Stewart's band at the Continental Club, which included Odell West.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: I don't know. The other thing that's interesting is that you did, of course, work with other bands out of Kansas City, didn't you. Did you work with Julia Lee?
Mmm-hmm. I worked a while out there with her.
And who else did you work with among those other Kansas City bands?
Dee Stewart -- they called him Prince Stewart. He had a little seven- or eight-piece band down at the Continental Club.
Anybody good in that, other than you? Anybody well known?
Odell. He was down there with us.
Odell? What was his other name?
Did you go on the road with those bands? Or were you only around Kansas City?
No. I just stayed right in Kansas City.
